name: vibewaiting
description: Vibe code without leaving your browser: a messenger overlay wired to local coding-agent sessions through Supercode.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node widget/build.mjs && node extension/build.mjs
scripts.dev:extension: node scripts/sync-local-supercode.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/dev-extension.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.widget.json && tsc -p tsconfig.extension.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.check:browser: npm run check && npm run test:widget
